title: Read a path parameter
summary: Gin: Read a path parameter. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: A colon marks a route value. GET /hello/Ravi puts Ravi in the name parameter.
learningObjectives: Read a path parameter with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Read a path parameter

blocks.text: Param reads Ravi from the named path part. String inserts it into the %s slot.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A route value is text until it is parsed and checked.
